mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 245.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.0%, it signals insufficient monetary tightening to combat inflation, triggering expectations of future rate hikes and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion (HOUST > 1200.0 thousand units), strong residential construction activity signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth falls below 50,000 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 50000 AND UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low CPI index levels (CPIAUCSL < 240.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the central bank's accommodative stance supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 240.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
